layers.title: Backscatter HH, 29 Jun
layers.caveat: Speckle is present. The scar darkens only slightly in backscatter; the standing-trunk explanation in docs/DOSSIER.md is a hypothesis, not a measurement. Coherence is the fire signal.

layers.title: Backscatter change HH, 29 Jun to 11 Jul
layers.caveat: After minus before, in dB: negative means a weaker return after the fire. Over most of the scene the change is a few tenths of a dB, and speckle dominates at pixel scale, so read the pattern, not single pixels.
